title: Orbital Remnants: Core Loop
summary: Prepare suit margins, enter fast, salvage cleanly, and leave before support runs thin.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Prepare suit systems, travel to the remnant, salvage a focused target, manage pressure or oxygen loss, return, and convert orbital parts into better gear.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each excursion, check oxygen, suit damage, cargo value, route timing, and shuttle access. Improve the weakest margin before going deeper.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Leave while the return path is still routine. Offworld salvage is won by getting home with the parts, not by touching one more crate.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
